title: Expiry and Lapse of Value — Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards Cardholder Terms
content:
Purchased Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards and Merchandise Credit Cards never expire and carry no monthly inactivity fee. A card whose kind's value expires — the Registry Reward Card and the Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card — expires on the day after its expiry date, and its remaining value then lapses in full, booked as an expiry write-off of that remaining value. An expired card is never reissued or extended. Balances of cards that do not expire are kept indefinitely, in line with the kind's unclaimed-property position.

## Position by kind

| Card kind | Expires | Inactivity fee charged | What happens to the remaining value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card (purchased) | Never | None | Kept indefinitely |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card (purchased) | Never | None | Kept indefinitely |
| Corporate Gift Card (purchased) | Never | None | Kept indefinitely |
| Merchandise Credit Card | Never | None | Kept indefinitely |
| Registry Reward Card | The day after its expiry date | — | Lapses in full on expiry |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | The day after its expiry date | — | Lapses in full on expiry |

## Timeline around the expiry date (hypothetical dates)

| Hypothetical day | Registry Reward Card with expiry date 30 September and $55.00 remaining |
|---|---|
| 30 September | The expiry date; the card is not yet expired |
| 1 October | The card expires; the $55.00 lapses in full as an expiry write-off |
| Any later day | The card stays expired; it is not reissued and its validity is not extended |

## Points of judgement

- *Is a part of the value kept when a card expires?* No. The remaining value lapses in full.
- *Can an expired card be brought back into use?* No. An expired card is never reissued or extended.
- *Does a Merchandise Credit Card lose value by sitting unused?* No. It never expires and carries no inactivity fee.
